metadata.title: SÚKL guideline PHV-6 version 4: requirements for reporting changes in the PSMF, appointing the QPPV and appointing the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic
metadata.edition: Version 4, replaces version 3 with effect from 31 January 2025 · contact person (Czech or Slovak, Czech phone number, resides in the EU); QPPV, contact person and PSMF changes to SÚKL within 7 calendar days (English)
metadata.legal_basis: SÚKL guideline issued under Sections 91 and 91a of Act No 378/2007 Coll.; legally binding per SÚKL; the official Czech text governs.
metadata.applicability: Marketing authorisation holders (see the PV Info SUKL-CZ national addendum; ICSR clocks are in the EMA rulebook).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

QPP V shall reside and operate in the EU , Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein. GVP Module I – Pharmacovigilance systems and their quality systems, defines the requirements to be fulfilled by QPP V . In order to carry out their activities, QPPVs must have - Both theoretical and practical knowledge for the performance of pharmacovigilance activities , - Expertise and access to expertise in the fields of medicine, pharmac eutical sciences , epidemiology, and biostatistics, - where the QPP V does not have medical education , the marketing authorisation holder shall ensure that the QPPV is assisted by a medically trained person and this assistance shall be duly documented .

candidates.context: The contact person for pharmacovigilance issues is a part of the m arketing a uthorization h older's pharmacovigilance system, whose responsibilities are set out and listed in the PSMF. The minimum responsibility of the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues is to provide the contact between SÚKL and the QPPV.
